Fit a REPAIR modified method-of-moments (M-MOM / M-MOMS) measurement-error model

Source: R/diagnose_crossrun_recovery.R
medusa_fit_mmom.Rd

Estimates a linear regression model when predictors, the outcome, or both are likelihood-only predictions measured with heteroscedastic sampling error (Vig & Hallquist, 2026). Delegates directly to repair::fit_mmom() when the repair package is installed and uses an identical built-in fallback otherwise.

Usage

medusa_fit_mmom(
  outcome,
  predictors,
  err_x,
  err_y = NULL,
  err_xy = NULL,
  regularization = c("step_up", "minimum", "none", "custom"),
  alpha = NULL,
  backend = c("auto", "r", "rcpp")
)

Arguments

outcome

Numeric outcome vector of length \(N\).

predictors

Numeric predictor matrix (\(N \times q\), excluding the intercept).

err_x

Numeric 3D array (\(q \times q \times N\)) of per-observation predictor sampling-error covariance matrices \(\hat{\boldsymbol{\Psi}}_{x,j}\).

err_y

Non-negative numeric vector of length \(N\) giving per-observation outcome sampling-error variances \(\hat{\psi}_{y,j}\).

err_xy

Optional numeric matrix (\(N \times q\)) of per-observation outcome-predictor sampling-error covariances \(\hat{\boldsymbol{\psi}}_{xy,j}^\top\).

regularization

Regularization policy: "step_up" (default; adaptive M-MOMS step-up search), "minimum" (fixed minimum \(\alpha = q + 2\)), "none", or "custom".

alpha

Optional custom regularization parameter when regularization = "custom".

backend

Computation backend passed to repair::fit_mmom() when available ("auto", "r", or "rcpp").

Value

A list with converged, coefficients (data.frame with term, estimate, se, zstat, pval, ci_low, ci_high), vcov, preliminary_coef, corrected_design_moment, analysis_weights, diagnostics, and repair_fit (the raw repair object when repair is installed).
